- [ ] Commit the protocol before runs; state what is exploratory.
- [ ] Record map cohorts, seeds, density, budgets and implementation variants.
- [ ] Preserve new raw exports, rejected-map audits, source revision and operator attribution.
- [ ] Use correct denominators and distinguish reused conditions from independent maps.
- [ ] Analyze failed or opposing cases as well as favorable outcomes.
- [ ] Update result documents, experiment log and the README's findings/limits when conclusions change.
